description: DEVELOPMENT ONLY, OPT-IN (enabled by tauri.dev.google.conf.json; never bundled into a release). Exactly Google's OIDC discovery origin (accounts.google.com), the only Google host Studio itself fetches. The authorization page opens in the system browser; the code-for-token exchange happens on the XO API (which holds the client secret), so no token or revocation origin is needed here.
